scripts.text: This is a restricted area. You can't come any further!
scripts.translation: 這裡是管制區域。你不能再往前了！

scripts.text: This is a restricted area. You can't come any further!
scripts.translation: 這裡是管制區域。你不能再往前了！

scripts.text: After that terrible incident wiped out the entire Morocc, Rune-Midgarts Kingdom has gathered us volunteers to help restorations.
scripts.translation: 夢羅克遭遇那場慘劇，整座城幾乎被毀後，盧恩·米德加茲王國召集我們這些志願者來協助重建。

scripts.text: As important as it seems, everyone's being careful but there are always some that really don't realize the situation, don't you think?
scripts.translation: 事情看起來很嚴重，大家也都很謹慎，可總有人完全沒意識到狀況，你不覺得嗎？
我們...我們忙得不可開交...

scripts.text: This work's like never-ending, no matter how hard we try!!!
scripts.translation: 不管怎麼努力，工作都永遠做不完！！！

scripts.text: People of Rune-Midgarts!! Please lend us a helping hand!!
scripts.translation: 盧恩·米德加茲的居民們！請伸出援手！！

scripts.text: We're still unable to estimate the overall damage.
scripts.translation: 我們仍然無法估算整體損失。

scripts.text: Adventurers' Union and Prontera Kingdom are putting their efforts on restorations as well as restraints of the original cause of the disaster.
scripts.translation: 冒險者聯盟和普隆德拉王國也在努力重建，同時設法遏止這場災難的根源。

scripts.text: Unless we settle the original cause, the damage will even spread out of Morocc. The only thing left is to get worse.
scripts.translation: 只要不解決災難的根源，損害就會蔓延到夢羅克以外。情況只會越來越糟。

scripts.text: As bad as it seems, we can't even ask for more support.
scripts.translation: 情況已經這麼糟了，我們甚至沒法再請求支援。

scripts.text: This sure must be the worst thing ever happened in Rune-Midgarts' history.
scripts.translation: 這肯定是盧恩·米德加茲歷史上最嚴重的災難。

scripts.text: I wish I knew how bad the damage is, but we can't even estimate it. It's like shovelling sand against the tide..
scripts.translation: 我真想知道損失有多嚴重，可我們連估算都做不到。就像逆流鏟沙一樣...

scripts.text: The town's all shattered, but the real problem is the towners.
scripts.translation: 城鎮被摧毀固然糟糕，真正棘手的是居民們。

scripts.text: It's a real pity to see those victims of the destroyed town, but the witnesses of the disaster are so much shocked. They're simply not normal now.
scripts.translation: 看到城鎮被毀、居民受害，實在令人難過。親眼目睹災難的人受到的驚嚇更大，現在精神都不太正常。

scripts.text: People are scared to death, but those are fortunate at least.. cause.. many others got mentally ill and stuff..
scripts.translation: 大家都嚇壞了，但至少他們還算幸運...很多人已經精神失常了...

scripts.text: Ugh.. It's kinda spooky, here.. Even this dry wind of the desert seems to have a dark nature.
scripts.translation: 唉...這裡有點陰森...連沙漠的幹風似乎都透著陰暗。

scripts.text: Ooh!! Something... I can feel something! The dark and gloomy air flowing around this town is actually giving me a musical motiff!
scripts.translation: 噢！！有感覺了...我感覺到了什麼！這座城鎮周圍流動的陰鬱氣息，竟然給了我音樂靈感！

scripts.text: Right, I think you should hear it! The title is.. 'The Rhapsody of Morocc Satan's Rebirth'!!
scripts.translation: 對，我覺得你應該聽聽！曲名是...《魔王夢羅克復活狂想曲》！！

scripts.text: When finally wake up, it's just the same darkness
scripts.translation: 終於醒來時，眼前依然只有黑暗

scripts.text: Failed to be reborn at the same place,
scripts.translation: 沒能在同一個地方復活，

scripts.text: Gotta try harder and harder, never ever give up,
scripts.translation: 只能一次又一次努力，絕不放棄，

scripts.text: But even after hundreds and thousands of trying,
The great Satan of Morocc can't revive~
scripts.translation: 夢羅克的偉大魔王還是無法復活~

scripts.text: My stupid button men are useless,
scripts.translation: 我那些笨手下真是沒用，
根本不是冒險者的對手，

scripts.text: Cracking the time and the space,
Will be saved for the last~~~
Be quiet! Can't you see what's going on?!
scripts.translation: 安靜！你沒看見現在是什麼情況嗎？！

scripts.text: Heyyy, you're being too harsh, Se�orita. Your fist may be as fragile as you are, but it sure can hurt somebody.
scripts.translation: 喂，小姐，你也太兇了吧。你的拳頭像你一樣纖弱，可打在人身上還真疼。

scripts.text: Anyways, isn't that a crib? I think I heard something like that before..
scripts.translation: 話說，那不是嬰兒床嗎？我以前好像聽過類似的聲音...

scripts.text: No, No way!? It,, sure is not!
scripts.translation: 不，不可能吧！？那...那肯定不是！

scripts.text: The town's completely destroyed, but that giant triangular structure hasn't been harmed at all. Maybe it's protected by some kinda special power.
scripts.translation: 整座城鎮都被毀了，唯獨那座巨大的三角形建築毫髮無損。也許有某種特殊力量保護著它。

scripts.text: You know...Those giant, triangular buildings at the NorthWest corner of Morocc known are known to us as Pyramids...
scripts.translation: 你知道嗎...夢羅克西北角那些巨大的三角形建築，我們稱它們為金字塔...

scripts.text: Those things have been around here for thousands and thousands of years. No one knows when and why they were built, or who built them.
scripts.translation: 那些建築已經矗立在這裡數千年了。沒人知道它們何時、為何或由誰建造。

scripts.text: All we know is that tons of monsters live inside those weird buildings. You might wanna stay away from those really dangerous places.
scripts.translation: 我們只知道那些奇怪的建築裡住著許多怪物。你最好離那些危險的地方遠點。

scripts.text: Those monsters in the Pyramid would be very, very sensitive to sweet flash smell of people....
scripts.translation: 金字塔裡的怪物似乎特別容易被人身上甜美的氣味吸引...

scripts.text: I've devoted my life to researching the mysterious pyramids near Morocc. I haven't been able to concretely confirm anything yet, but...
scripts.translation: 我畢生都在研究夢羅克附近神秘的金字塔。雖然還沒能確切證實任何事情，不過...

scripts.text: I'm sure that the largest pyramid contains the tomb of the ancient king, Osiris! I'm willing to stake my life on it!
scripts.translation: 我確信最大的金字塔裡埋葬著古代國王俄賽里斯！我願意拿性命擔保！

scripts.text: I remember I said the bandits of desert are the desert wolves.. Those bastards always roam around in a bunch and they would get so cruel and outrageous if one of them got attacked.
scripts.translation: 我記得跟你說過，沙漠裡的強盜就是沙漠之狼...那些混蛋總是成群結隊地出沒，只要其中一隻遭到攻擊，它們就會變得殘暴又蠻橫。

scripts.text: They are so vicious, and I'm telling ya, I'm no kidding. You can only find some bones and rotten milk in the backpack after these wolves sweep through.
scripts.translation: 它們兇得很，我可沒開玩笑。那些狼群經過後，背包裡只剩骨頭和變質牛奶。

scripts.text: Those things are so mean and vicious..
But the thing is that.. I even kinda feel those merciless cold-blooded monsters are nothing to be afraid of, compared to what has happened in Morocc. Morocc is already a hell.
scripts.translation: 不過話說回來...和夢羅克發生的事相比，我甚至覺得那些冷血無情的怪物也沒什麼可怕。夢羅克已經成了地獄。

scripts.text: I work in the trading business, so I always have to cross the hot, dry Morocc Desert on business.
scripts.translation: 我做貿易生意，所以經常為了工作穿越炎熱乾燥的夢羅克沙漠。

scripts.text: But I can't do that anymore.
scripts.translation: 但我現在再也做不到了。

scripts.text: Now that I can't, I kind of miss the old days.
scripts.translation: 如今不能再去，反倒有點懷念過去的日子。

scripts.text: Like this one time, while I was in the middle of the desert, I got so thirsty that I caught a cactus.. but before I was able to cut it, it slapped me! Then it shot me in the arse with all these needles...
scripts.translation: 有一次我在沙漠裡渴得不行，抓住一棵仙人掌...可還沒來得及切開，它就扇了我一巴掌！然後還用渾身的刺扎我屁股...

scripts.text: Later, I learned that it wasn't a normal cactus I found, but the monster we call 'Muka.'
scripts.translation: 後來我才知道，那不是普通的仙人掌，而是我們稱作“摩卡”的怪物。

scripts.text: Now I come to think of it, it was fun as much as dangerous.
scripts.translation: 現在想來，那經歷雖然危險，卻也挺有趣。

scripts.text: The undisputed queen of jewels has to be the Diamond. After looking at it just once, no one can deny its beauty.
scripts.translation: 說到珠寶，公認的女王非鑽石莫屬。只要看過一次，就沒人能否認它的美。

scripts.text: Many factors determine its value, but the most important thing is its size.
scripts.translation: 鑽石的價值取決於很多因素，但最重要的是大小。

scripts.text: It should also be a perfect crystal, not cracked or chipped, if you want to sell the Diamond for a lot of zeny.
scripts.translation: 想賣個好價錢的話，鑽石還得是完整的晶體，不能有裂痕或缺角。

scripts.text: But look! The hardest stone in the world got broken in two!
scripts.translation: 可你看！世界上最堅硬的寶石竟然裂成了兩半！

scripts.text: I know it's not the time to worry about some gemstones but.. this.. was my everything..
scripts.translation: 我知道現在不是擔心寶石的時候，可是...這...是我的全部...

scripts.text: Wait a second..! Are you perhaps an adventurer? Welcome! How's your trip?
scripts.translation: 等一下...你是冒險者嗎？歡迎！旅途怎麼樣？

scripts.text: Heh heh~ Let me tell you a story. You know I just got out of that Tavern, there, huh?
scripts.translation: 嘿嘿~我給你講個故事。你知道嗎，我剛從那邊的酒館出來，嗯？

scripts.text: I heard the Satan Morocc has revived. It just got out of cracking the time and the space blar... hic~
scripts.translation: 我聽說魔王夢羅克復活了。它剛撕裂時空現身，嗝...呃~

scripts.text: Ah... I kinda wanna see that Satan with my own eyes, but! I really shouldn't. I shouldn't even dream of seeing that Satan in person.
scripts.translation: 啊...我有點想親眼看看那個魔王，可是！還是別了。我連想都不該想見到它本人。

scripts.text: But I think there'd be nothing to lose if you, a person of bravery, who came through the wile desert try to find it, don't you think? Teehee~ Don't forget to buy me a drink when you find it!
scripts.translation: 不過，像你這樣穿越險惡沙漠而來的勇者，去找它看看也沒什麼損失吧？嘿嘿~找到了可別忘了請我喝一杯！

scripts.text: Anyway, do you know where we are? I just had a little drink at a tavern, but all of a sudden, the whole town's disappeared when I got out.. or, some five hundred years have passed???!
scripts.translation: 對了，你知道我們在哪兒嗎？我剛才只是在酒館喝了一小會兒，可一出來整座城鎮就消失了...還是說，已經過去五百年了？！

scripts.text: ... That day... I saw the bloody moon in the sky. It was too silent that it felt so spooky.
scripts.translation: ...那一天...我看見天空中出現血色的月亮。四周寂靜得令人毛骨悚然。

scripts.text: Not even a whistle of dry wind, and the air so heavy and stuffy, I could hardly breathe.
scripts.translation: 連一絲沙漠幹風的聲音都沒有，空氣又沉又悶，讓我幾乎無法呼吸。

scripts.text: But then, Bang! It was right that time that I saw the enormous amount of smoke rising up at the Castle of Morocc with an earsplitting sound.
scripts.translation: 可就在那時，砰的一聲！我看見大量濃煙從夢羅克城堡升起，還伴隨著震耳欲聾的巨響。

scripts.text: All happened so fast. The Oasis of the Castle was all dried up and the town was destroyed. And... and that voice... I heard a voice.
scripts.translation: 一切發生得太快了。城堡的綠洲乾涸了，城鎮也被毀了。還有...還有那個聲音...我聽到了一個聲音。

scripts.text: Blood... Blood is what it takes to pay for the soul... and that dark sound of laughter...
scripts.translation: 血...要用血來償還靈魂...還有那陰森的笑聲...

scripts.text: Aah!!! It's... It's still ringing in my ears!!! Aahhhhh!!!!
scripts.translation: 啊！！！它...它還在我耳邊迴響！！！啊啊啊！！

scripts.text: - It'd be better not to disturb him anymore -
I'm so scared! Where's mom and dad...! hhooooo... Where's our house...
scripts.translation: 我好害怕！媽媽和爸爸在哪裡...！嗚嗚嗚...我們的家呢...

scripts.text: Please stop crying, Eliese... You could even faint if you cry all day long, you know...
scripts.translation: 別哭了，艾莉絲...你要是整天哭，可能會暈倒的...

scripts.text: Right, you love ice-cream, don't you? I.. I can get you an ice-cream if you stop crying. Don't cry, Eliese, please.. Ok? Don't...
scripts.translation: 對了，你喜歡冰淇淋吧？我...我去給你拿冰淇淋，只要你別哭。別哭，艾莉絲，求你了...好嗎？別...

scripts.text: The fields of Rune-Midgarts are infested with wild and dangerous monsters..But, you've got to admit a bunch of them are soooo cute!
scripts.translation: 盧恩·米德加茲的原野上到處都是兇猛危險的怪物...不過，你也得承認，其中有不少真的超可愛！

scripts.text: You know, like how Spore sticks out its tongue after you kill it..
scripts.translation: 比如魔菇被打倒後會吐舌頭...

scripts.text: Or, how little Picky wears that tiny egg shell sometimes?..
scripts.translation: 還有小雞，有時候會戴著小小的蛋殼呢...

scripts.text: I can't believe what just has happened.. Our town used to be the one with those cute little monsters, not that kinda of vicious dreadful Evil sleeping in! Whew...
scripts.translation: 真不敢相信剛才發生的一切...我們這裡以前到處都是可愛的小怪物，怎麼會有那麼兇惡可怕的邪惡存在沉睡在這裡！呼...

scripts.text: I'm so scared... I just wanna ease my mind watching over those cute little Porings...
scripts.translation: 我好害怕...只想看看那些可愛的波利，讓自己安心一點...

scripts.text: Ooh! Angeling is just like Poring, except it has angel wings! Of course, I don't know if they can actually fly..
scripts.translation: 噢！天使波利就像波利，只是長著天使翅膀！當然，我也不知道它們是不是真的會飛...

scripts.text: Angelings are rarely seen, but can be found among large groups of Porings living in one of the fields south of Prontera.
scripts.translation: 天使波利很少出現，但在普隆德拉南邊某個原野上的大群波利中能找到它們。

scripts.text: Angeling is a high level monster with Holy property, so it's immune to most magic, aside from spells that have Neutral or Shadow attack properties.
scripts.translation: 天使波利是高等級聖屬性怪物，所以大多數魔法對它都無效，只有無屬性或暗屬性攻擊的法術例外。

scripts.text: Hehe~ Don't you think I know a lot about Porings? I love them soooo much
scripts.translation: 嘿嘿~你覺得我是不是很瞭解波利？我可喜歡它們了~

scripts.text: Ghostring is an evil ghost Poring. It's rarely seen, but can be found among mass groups of Porings living in one of the fields south of Prontera.
scripts.translation: 幽靈波利是邪惡的幽靈波利。它很少出現，但在普隆德拉南邊某個原野上的大群波利中能找到它。

scripts.text: Ghostring is a high-leveled monster with the Ghost property, so it can withstand all physical attacks.
scripts.translation: 幽靈波利是高等級幽靈屬性怪物，所以能抵擋所有物理攻擊。

scripts.text: Damage can only be caused to Ghostring through magic spells or weapons with an a specific property.
scripts.translation: 只有用魔法或帶有特定屬性的武器才能對幽靈波利造成傷害。

scripts.text: Hehe~ Don't you think I know a lot about Porings? I love them soooo much~
scripts.translation: 嘿嘿~你覺得我是不是很瞭解波利？我可喜歡它們了~

scripts.text: Hey, you. Did you cross the desert?
When you walk through the desert about one map North and 3 maps East, you'll find the entrance to Ant Hell.
scripts.translation: 從這裡往北走一張地圖，再往東走三張地圖，就能找到螞蟻地獄的入口。

scripts.text: There are two different entrances to the Ant Hell. When you get inside, the 1st and the 2nd underground levels of winding looking caves are connected to each other.
scripts.translation: 螞蟻地獄有兩個入口。進去之後，彎彎曲曲的洞窟一層和地下二層是相通的。

scripts.text: I'm really wondered how those entrances are after the horrible destruction, but I can't go out.. If you ever hear anything about it, please get me informed.
scripts.translation: 那場可怕的破壞之後，入口會變成什麼樣，我真想知道，可我沒法出去...如果聽到任何訊息，請告訴我。

scripts.text: That cave is sure a dangerous hell, sticky and all... There are 2 underground levels.
scripts.translation: 那座洞窟真是危險又黏糊糊的地獄...一共有地下兩層。

scripts.text: Just head East till you see the bridge which connects to the Payon Forest.
scripts.translation: 一直往東走，直到看見通往斐揚森林的橋。

scripts.text: In the map right before that bridge, head north to find the entrance to Ant Hell, though I'm not sure if it's still there.
scripts.translation: 就在那座橋前一張地圖，往北走就能找到螞蟻地獄的入口，不過我不確定它現在還在不在。

scripts.text: Ant Hell is swarming with Ant monsters. You'll notice that they all classed with different names...
scripts.translation: 螞蟻地獄裡到處都是螞蟻怪物。你會發現它們都各有不同的名字...

scripts.text: Andre is the weakest, Piere is comparatively average, and Deniro is the strongest Ant. Keep that in mind so you can fight the Ants suitable to your level.
scripts.translation: 白蟻最弱，工蟻實力中等，兵蟻最強。記住這些，就能選擇適合自己等級的螞蟻來打。

scripts.text: Andre is colored in Ivory, Yellowish Green is Piere, and the Red one is Deniro.
scripts.translation: 白蟻是象牙色，工蟻是黃綠色，紅色的是兵蟻。

scripts.text: It's really easy to distinguish those from Bitata, the common ants because they look very different.
scripts.translation: 它們和普通的比塔塔螞蟻長得很不一樣，很容易分辨。

scripts.text: Oh, and those ants are greedy as Porings and will try to steal your items, so keep that in mind.
scripts.translation: 對了，那些螞蟻和波利一樣貪心，會偷你的物品，記住要小心。

scripts.text: If you ever, could cross the desert without any disturbances from the Satan...
scripts.translation: 要是你能不受魔王干擾地穿越沙漠就好了...

scripts.text: There's also an old man called Guias, the spirit of the earth. He's pretty hard to deal with.
scripts.translation: 還有個叫古亞斯的老人，據說是大地精靈。他很難對付。

scripts.text: Sharp teeth and strong jaws of the ants would be something that you should be careful of, but the shovelling skills of that old grandpa is very strong that you should watch out.
scripts.translation: 螞蟻的尖牙和強壯的下顎確實要小心，不過那個老爺爺的鏟土本領也很厲害，千萬別大意。

scripts.text: ...Well, what am I talking about? What is left to be afraid when the Satan of Morocc is revived? Huh..huhhuh...
scripts.translation: ...我在說什麼呢？魔王夢羅克都復活了，還有什麼好怕的？呵...呵呵...

scripts.text: Unbeatable in man-to-man fights, Assassins always overcome their enemies! Erm, always overcome their enemies without a trace.
scripts.translation: 單挑從無敗績，刺客總能戰勝敵人！呃，總能無聲無息地解決敵人。

scripts.text: But what did they do when this destruction happened in Morocc!!!
scripts.translation: 可夢羅克發生這場災難時，他們到底做了什麼！！！

scripts.text: Where I can find the Assassin clan?
scripts.translation: 我在哪裡能找到刺客組織？

scripts.text: I hear Assassins practice killing people, quietly and stealthfully..
scripts.translation: 我聽說刺客會練習如何悄無聲息地殺人...

scripts.text: I left home three years ago, and have been searching for their secret base ever since...
scripts.translation: 我三年前離開家，從那時起就一直在尋找他們的秘密基地...

scripts.text: Well.. Maybe it'd too late now..
scripts.translation: 唉...也許現在已經太遲了...

scripts.text: Now that the whole town's destroyed... I don't even care what happens next...
scripts.translation: 整座城鎮都毀了...接下來會發生什麼，我也不在乎了...

scripts.text: It seemed to be impossible to find.
scripts.translation: 看來那個地方根本找不到。

scripts.text: Well, I hear that if you leave this town and go 2 maps east, and then 2 maps South, you should be able to find it..
scripts.translation: 聽說離開這座城鎮後往東走兩張地圖，再往南走兩張地圖，就能找到它...

scripts.text: The 'Mirage Tower,' the head building of Sograt Desert, is supposed to appear in this awesome sandstorm! But, I still haven't found it.
scripts.translation: 據說蘇克拉特沙漠的主建築“幻影之塔”會在壯觀的沙塵暴中出現！可我到現在還沒找到。

scripts.text: If you find them, and the clan master thinks you're qualified, you can become an Assassin! Or, at least, I think..
scripts.translation: 找到他們之後，如果首領覺得你合格，你就能成為刺客！至少我是這麼聽說的...

scripts.text: And I hear the coolest Assassin of them all is the Assassin Cross! But, that's even a bigger mystery~ You won't be able to see them unless you're a great thief!
scripts.translation: 我還聽說最厲害的刺客是十字刺客！不過那更是個謎~除非你是了不起的盜賊，否則根本見不到他們！

scripts.text: But then... What the hell were they doing when Morocc was destroyed?!!!
scripts.translation: 可是...夢羅克被毀時，他們到底在做什麼？！！！

scripts.text: Assassin is one of the advanced jobs for Thief, and specializes in fighting with Neutral and Poison property attacks.
scripts.translation: 刺客是盜賊的進階職業之一，擅長使用無屬性和毒屬性攻擊作戰。

scripts.text: They're also very sneaky! I hear that they're able to cloak so that no one can see them!
scripts.translation: 他們也非常擅長隱匿！聽說他們能隱身，讓別人看不見！

scripts.text: But then... What the hell were they doing when Morocc was destroyed?!!!
scripts.translation: 可是...夢羅克被毀時，他們到底在做什麼？！！！

scripts.text: The desert of Morocc has the highest average temperature in Midgard. You might as well think twice before you sit on the sand in the middle of the desert, cause your ass will be toasted.
scripts.translation: 夢羅克沙漠的平均氣溫是米德加爾特最高的。你最好想清楚再坐到沙漠正中央的沙地上，不然屁股會被烤熟。

scripts.text: It seems like it should be all burnt, but it's not!
scripts.translation: 看起來好像會被烤焦，結果卻沒有！

scripts.text: You can sit down and take a rest whenever you need to and your ass won't burn. I guess the Morocc sand doesn't conduct heat as much as it should.
scripts.translation: 想休息時儘管坐下，屁股不會被燙傷。我想夢羅克的沙子沒有那麼容易傳熱。

scripts.text: That's why everyone could recover the HP and SP in the middle of desert.
scripts.translation: 所以大家才能在沙漠中央恢復HP和SP。

scripts.text: Now I come to think of it, maybe the reason why Morocc has exceptionally high average temperature is because that Satan is sealed within.
scripts.translation: 現在想來，夢羅克平均氣溫特別高，也許是因為魔王被封印在地下深處。

scripts.text: That's what the potions are for!
Red Potions have become steadily popular since they're so affordable, even though they only recover a little bit of HP.
scripts.translation: 紅色藥水價格實惠，雖然只能恢復少量HP，但一直很受歡迎。

scripts.text: Try this bottle of ice-cold potion when you go into the Oasis around the Pyramid...
scripts.translation: 去金字塔附近的綠洲時，試試這瓶冰涼的藥水...

scripts.text: Yeah.. you want this bad.. but the situation's not good...
scripts.translation: 是啊...你很想要這個，可現在情況不太好...

scripts.text: Sometimes 'Milk' comes out of 'PecoPeco's Egg.' Now..
scripts.translation: 有時候“乳汁”會從“波波利的蛋”裡出來。現在...

scripts.text: I'm not sure how the cow's milk comes out of some bird's egg...
scripts.translation: 我也不明白牛奶怎麼會從鳥蛋裡出來...

scripts.text: I may not be a man of science, but how is that even possible?.
scripts.translation: 我雖然不懂科學，但這怎麼可能呢？

scripts.text: I mean, did the Milk come prepackaged with the egg, or did it get in there somehow?..
scripts.translation: 我是說，牛奶是裝好後放進蛋裡的，還是用什麼辦法弄進去的？

scripts.text: Oh, whatever.. It's just not the time for this.
scripts.translation: 算了...現在不是討論這個的時候。

scripts.text: I... I really saw it.... The Fly Lord gets shattered in pieces in a blink of an eye...
scripts.translation: 我...我真的看見了...龍蠅領主眨眼間就被打得粉碎...

scripts.text: What is really going on? Would it be possible for us to survive??
scripts.translation: 到底發生什麼事了？我們還能活下去嗎？

scripts.text: Yes, yes! I'm talking about the Dragon Fly, master of all flies!!
scripts.translation: 對，對！我說的是龍蠅，所有蒼蠅的首領！！

scripts.text: The Dragon Fly is a special one that stays in the North-east of the town.
scripts.translation: 龍蠅是一隻特殊的怪物，住在城鎮東北方。

scripts.text: It's so much stronger than the other flies.
And when you kill it, there's even a chance that you might earn a ^880000Clip^000000 item!
scripts.translation: 打倒它時，還有機率獲得^880000髮夾^000000！

scripts.text: Anyways, don't you think the Satan Morocc is so cruel?
scripts.translation: 總之，你不覺得夢羅克魔王太殘忍了嗎？

scripts.text: They may not be the same kind, but still isn't it cruel to take that monster's soul with a single blow?
scripts.translation: 雖然不是同一種生物，可一擊奪走那隻怪物的靈魂，不也很殘忍嗎？

scripts.text: What should we do when this dreadful evil has come to life again!
scripts.translation: 這可怕的邪惡再次復活，我們該怎麼辦！

scripts.text: Morocc is located in an extremely dry region, surrounded by desert.
scripts.translation: 夢羅克位於極其乾燥的地區，四周都是沙漠。

scripts.text: No place in the world is as hot as Morocc.
scripts.translation: 世界上沒有比夢羅克更炎熱的地方。

scripts.text: I have a hunch that this hot and dry climate in Morocc is because of that Satan sealed deeper underground for so long.
scripts.translation: 我猜夢羅克又熱又幹，是因為魔王長期被封印在地下深處。

scripts.text: Um.. I'll briefly tell ya about the desert if you want to know.
scripts.translation: 嗯...你想了解沙漠的話，我可以簡單說說。

scripts.text: Due to low annual rainfall, low humidity and high evaporation rate, little vegetation can be found in the desert.
scripts.translation: 由於年降雨量低、溼度低、蒸發率高，沙漠裡幾乎沒有植物。

scripts.text: Nonetheless, there are a few hardy plants that can survive and grow in the desert.
scripts.translation: 不過，也有幾種耐旱植物能在沙漠中生存和生長。

scripts.text: Unfortunately some of those plants growing around Morocc have been mutated into monsters.
scripts.translation: 可惜，夢羅克附近生長的一些植物已經變異成怪物。

scripts.text: One of those is Muka, the mutated cactus..
scripts.translation: 其中一種就是變異仙人掌摩卡...

scripts.text: However, now that the Satan has revived, no one's sure of what changes would be made in the life cycles of Morocc.
scripts.translation: 不過，魔王既然復活了，誰也不知道夢羅克的生態會發生什麼變化。

scripts.text: Oh, I curse you, the desert of Morocc!!
But our of all this hatred, I didn't want it to be completely destroyed...
scripts.translation: 可即使我有這麼多怨恨，也不希望它徹底毀滅...

scripts.text: How come it's never possible to know its value while it's still around?
scripts.translation: 為什麼總要等到失去之後，才知道它的可貴？
